tool.name: OpenAI Codex
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.description: OpenAI coding agent available as an open-source CLI, IDE extension, ChatGPT app surfaces and hosted Codex Cloud tasks.
tool.licenseWarning: Only the Codex CLI in openai/codex is Apache 2.0. Codex Cloud, the ChatGPT app surfaces and the models it calls are proprietary OpenAI services under ChatGPT or API terms.
tool.pricing: Included in ChatGPT Free, Go ($8/mo), Plus ($20/mo), Pro (from $100/mo), Business ($20/user/mo annual, 2+ users) and Enterprise/Edu (contact sales); or API-key usage at API rates.
tool.practitionerNote: Separate local clients from Codex Cloud in workspace RBAC; OpenAI notes the Compliance API does not record every local command or file operation, so pair it with endpoint controls. Use API keys, not seats, for CI automation.

dataResidency.detail: Data and inference residency apply only to eligible content and supported workloads, subject to agreement, region and configuration; not supported with UAE inference residency.

deployment.detail: Local CLI/IDE/desktop clients plus OpenAI-hosted Codex Cloud; no self-hosted model option.

auditLogging.detail: Compliance API append-only stream with codex_log, conversation_message and AUTH_LOG events; OTel events for local use; does not capture every local command or file operation.

soc2.detail: OpenAI SOC 2 Type 2 (Jul 2025-Jun 2026) covers ChatGPT Enterprise/Edu/Team and API Platform; Codex-specific scope not separately listed.

iso27001.detail: OpenAI ISO/IEC 27001:2022 covers ChatGPT business plans and API Platform; Codex-specific scope not separately listed.

iso42001.detail: OpenAI ISO/IEC 42001:2023 listed on trust portal for ChatGPT business plans and API Platform; Codex-specific scope not separately listed.

euAiAct.detail: Assessed limited-risk by product category (general-purpose assistant); no published OpenAI EU AI Act conformity statement for this product.

licenseRisk.detail: CLI is Apache 2.0 (permissive) but depends on proprietary OpenAI models and Codex Cloud.
